command: pre-registration of P6 (the learned pose reader in place of the oracle)

metrics.arm: phasebind_reader: P1's arm B (phasebind_nofold: the demo's phases with object-relative bindings through the frozen prior, no fold) with the object poses from a LEARNED reader in place of the client's simulator state (the client sends no object state). Reader (experiments/p6_reader.py): per task, a standardized ridge regression from the frozen ImageNet ResNet-18 features of both cameras (VinnPolicy._embed) of the episode's FIRST frame to the 3-D positions of the task's objects of interest; trained on the first 20 frames of the recorded practice episodes of init states 0-29 (positions from their bit-exact replays), the penalty chosen by cross-validation grouped by init state; the orientations are the demo's (every recorded init state has the demo's object orientations: 0 degrees median); the carry uses no live held-object pose (C = I)

hypotheses.A: phasebind_reader - dimfold_s1_last2 (dimcode_s1 where the demo grasps nothing) >= +0.11 with an exact two-sided sign test p < 0.05 (P1's criterion without privileged state)
hypotheses.N: PRIMARY (the plan's headline condition): phasebind_reader non-inferior to the oracle arm phasebind_nofold at -0.10: one-sided 95% lower bound of the paired difference (two-level bootstrap) >= -0.10
hypotheses.descriptive: per-task gap to the oracle and the reader's offline error per object

metrics.offline: ledger p6_reader tag offline: trained on states 0-19, tested on the first frame of states 20-29
metrics.plan: docs/PLAN_TRANSFER.md P6: does P1's result survive without the simulator oracle?
metrics.tasks: P1's 9 tasks 42, 32, 1, 35, 40, 36, 52, 62, 41; init states 30-49 (never used to train the reader); 180 paired
metrics.written_before: any phasebind_reader rollout of the read (a smoke test on task 52, experiment smoke, is excluded)
